Description (SPA): Circunscripcion plurinominal a la que pertenece el distrito.
Description (ENG): Plurinominal constituency grouping federal districts for proportional-representation seats.
Notes: Mexico is divided into 5 circunscripciones for Chamber of Deputies PR seats.

Description (SPA): Identificador numerico del estado.
Description (ENG): Numeric state ID.
Notes: Matches INEGI state catalog.

Description (SPA): Nombre completo del estado.
Description (ENG): Full state name.
Notes: Used for display; ID_ESTADO is safer for joins.

Description (SPA): Identificador del distrito electoral federal dentro del estado.
Description (ENG): Federal electoral district ID within the state.
Values / Domain: 0 = voto en el extranjero; 1-N per state.
Notes: Not unique nationwide; combine with ID_ESTADO.

Description (SPA): Ciudad o localidad cabecera del distrito federal.
Description (ENG): Main city or head municipality of the federal district.
Values / Domain: e.g. JESUS MARIA, VOTO EN EL EXTRANJERO.
Notes: Maps to dim_geography.cabecera_distrital_federal.

Description (SPA): Identificador del municipio dentro del estado.
Description (ENG): Municipality ID within the state.
Values / Domain: 0 = voto en el extranjero; 1-N within state.
Notes: Not unique nationwide; combine with ID_ESTADO.

Description (SPA): Nombre del municipio.
Description (ENG): Municipality name.
Values / Domain: e.g. ASIENTOS, VOTO EN EL EXTRANJERO.
Notes: Maps to dim_geography.municipio.

Description (SPA): Seccion electoral donde esta ubicada la casilla.
Description (ENG): Electoral section where the polling station is located.
Notes: Unique only within a state.

Description (SPA): Tipo de casilla electoral instalada.
Description (ENG): Type of polling station installed.
Notes: MEC is used for counting tables such as electronic or overseas vote rows.

Description (SPA): Numero secuencial de la casilla principal dentro de su tipo y seccion.
Description (ENG): Sequential number of the main polling station within its type and section.
Notes: Does not distinguish contiguous extensions; use EXT_CONTIGUA too.

Description (SPA): Numero secuencial de la extension contigua dentro de una misma casilla.
Description (ENG): Sequential counter of contiguous extensions within the same polling-station identity.
Notes: Composite identity uses ID_ESTADO + SECCION + TIPO_CASILLA + ID_CASILLA + EXT_CONTIGUA.

Description (SPA): Clave alfanumerica que codifica tipo, numero de casilla y extension.
Description (ENG): Alphanumeric key encoding type, polling-station number, and extension.
Notes: Most robust natural key for the source row together with state/context.

Description (SPA): Indica si se uso urna electronica en esta casilla.
Description (ENG): Flag indicating whether an electronic ballot box was used.
Notes: Only present in specific pilot/special contexts.

Description (SPA): Votos obtenidos por el PAN.
Description (ENG): Votes for Partido Accion Nacional.
Notes: Converted to party_key PAN.

Description (SPA): Votos obtenidos por el PRI.
Description (ENG): Votes for Partido Revolucionario Institucional.
Notes: Converted to party_key PRI.

Description (SPA): Votos obtenidos por el PRD.
Description (ENG): Votes for Partido de la Revolucion Democratica.
Notes: Converted to party_key PRD.

Description (SPA): Votos obtenidos por el PVEM.
Description (ENG): Votes for Partido Verde Ecologista de Mexico.
Notes: Converted to party_key PVEM.

Description (SPA): Votos obtenidos por el PT.
Description (ENG): Votes for Partido del Trabajo.
Notes: Converted to party_key PT.

Description (SPA): Votos obtenidos por Movimiento Ciudadano.
Description (ENG): Votes for Movimiento Ciudadano.
Notes: Converted to party_key MC.

Description (SPA): Votos obtenidos por MORENA.
Description (ENG): Votes for MORENA.
Notes: Converted to party_key MORENA.

Description (SPA): Votos para la coalicion PAN-PRI-PRD.
Description (ENG): Votes for the PAN-PRI-PRD coalition ballot.
Notes: Voters chose the coalition emblem rather than an individual party emblem.

Description (SPA): Votos para la coalicion parcial PAN-PRI.
Description (ENG): Votes for the PAN-PRI sub-coalition ballot.
Notes: Coalition combination vote option.

Description (SPA): Votos para la coalicion parcial PAN-PRD.
Description (ENG): Votes for the PAN-PRD sub-coalition ballot.
Notes: Coalition combination vote option.

Description (SPA): Votos para la coalicion parcial PRI-PRD.
Description (ENG): Votes for the PRI-PRD sub-coalition ballot.
Notes: Coalition combination vote option.

Description (SPA): Votos para la coalicion PVEM-PT-MORENA.
Description (ENG): Votes for the PVEM-PT-MORENA coalition ballot.
Notes: Coalition combination vote option.

Description (SPA): Votos para la coalicion parcial PVEM-PT.
Description (ENG): Votes for the PVEM-PT sub-coalition ballot.
Notes: Coalition combination vote option.

Description (SPA): Votos para la coalicion parcial PVEM-MORENA.
Description (ENG): Votes for the PVEM-MORENA sub-coalition ballot.
Notes: Coalition combination vote option.

Description (SPA): Votos para la coalicion parcial PT-MORENA.
Description (ENG): Votes for the PT-MORENA sub-coalition ballot.
Notes: Coalition combination vote option.

Description (SPA): Suma de votos validos emitidos.
Description (ENG): Sum of all valid votes cast.
Notes: Party and coalition votes; excludes null votes and non-registered candidate votes.

Description (SPA): Votos a candidaturas no registradas.
Description (ENG): Votes cast for write-in or non-registered candidates.
Notes: Legally recognized category but not assigned to a registered party.

Description (SPA): Votos nulos.
Description (ENG): Null votes.
Notes: Blank, over-marked, or otherwise invalid ballots.

Description (SPA): Total de votos contabilizados en el acta.
Description (ENG): Total votes recorded in the ballot count record.
Notes: Should equal valid votes + non-registered votes + null votes.

Description (SPA): Numero de ciudadanos habilitados para votar en esta casilla.
Description (ENG): Number of registered voters eligible to vote at this polling station.
Notes: Special casillas and overseas rows need careful turnout treatment.

Description (SPA): Estado de procesamiento del acta.
Description (ENG): Processing status of the ballot count record.
Notes: Distinguishes counted/verified records from quality exceptions.

Description (SPA): Indica intervencion del Tribunal Electoral.
Description (ENG): Flag indicating Electoral Tribunal review or modification.
Notes: Relevant mainly after legal review/post-election processes.

Description (SPA): Nombre o ruta del archivo PDF del acta digitalizada.
Description (ENG): Filename or path of the scanned ballot count record.
Notes: Can be used to retrieve the original scanned acta.

Description (SPA): Observaciones del acta o referencia adicional.
Description (ENG): Acta observations or additional reference.
Notes: May mirror RUTA_ACTA or contain processing notes depending on file.
